text:
Missed doses are the most common reason a treatment plan stops working, and the fix is boring in the best way. Every Sunday at the same time, right after breakfast for most people, fill a seven-day pill organizer. Set one phone alarm per dose time and name it after the pill, not just alarm, and treat snooze as off limits. Count what is left in each bottle, and if it is under ten days, order the refill today instead of the day it runs out. Keep a one-line note of anything new, dizzy, rash, sleepy, and bring that note to your next appointment, it makes the visit shorter and more useful. Ask your pharmacist or care team before changing anything about how you take your medicine. Save this and share it with someone who manages a lot.
